ci-bot: 🚨 main build failed on pipeline smoke-suite (post-merge)
ci-bot: Failed jobs: smoke-e2e (stage: integration), flaky-check
ci-bot: https://ci.redwood.example/build/12345
alex: who touched the smoke suite recently? @marta @ryan
marta: i added a small fixture change yesterday that touched auth mocks — might be related
ryan: i merged #5123 earlier this morning (token cache tweak) — could be interaction
alex: can someone grab logs and post the failing test name? quick grep should show it
olivia: grabbing logs now, rerunning the smoke-e2e locally
olivia: failing test: tests/e2e/session_timeout.test.js::SessionTimeout resets token
olivia: stack: AssertionError: expected 401 but got 200
olivia: looks like token invalidation didn't happen in the environment
marta: hmm my fixture change updated mock TTL from 1s -> 1000ms, maybe boundary issue
ryan: the token cache change touched refresh timing — possible race
alex: okay let's bisect between last green and this merge. @ci-bot can you rerun the failed job with --rerun-all but keep logs
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled: smoke-e2e on main (#12345) by alex — attempting rerun on same agent pool
olivia: i can reproduce locally by forcing short TTL, working on a minimal repro
marta: if you can reproduce, post the snippet. I can revert my test fixture if needed
ryan: pinging owner of #5123 (ryan) — i'll do a quick revert PR if rerun stays red
alex: if rerun passes, we'll mark as flaky and open a follow-up. if red, start bisect: revert r=5123 then rerun
olivia: rerun started, logs streaming: "SessionTimeout resets token — FAILED (500ms)"
ci-bot: Rerun result: FAILED (same test)
alex: ok bisect plan: (1) revert #5123 in a temporary branch, (2) revert marta's fixture change, test each, (3) escalate
marta: i'll open a revert PR for my fixture change now: #5135
ryan: i'll prepare revert for #5123 and link here when ready
olivia: adding a quick local patch to shorten cache window to replicate upstream more closely
alex: thanks — keep this thread updated. if either revert makes CI green we can merge back with a fix. :thumbsup:
marta: revert PR open: https://git.redwood.example/pulls/5135 — requesting cole for review
ryan: revert ready at https://git.redwood.example/pulls/5136 — will queue for CI once reviewers added
alex: assigning rollback steps and tagging oncall if we fail to get green in 20m
ci-bot: Notifying eng-oncall: @oncall-eng — main pipeline is red and bisect in progress
olivia: note: failing test prints token header: X-Token-Expiry: 0 — suspicious
alex: good catch, could be TTL rounding to zero. ryan/marta focus on rounding logic in cache and fixture
marta: on it, will add a guard against zero TTL in mocks
ryan: will add a quick fix and run unit tests, then we can re-run smoke-suite
alex: appreciate the quick response everyone. we'll reconvene in this thread with CI status updates.
